data.completion_memo: Implemented shared V1 protocol primitives: validated stable IDs and process generations, explicit schema versions, base envelope/payload families, bounded four-byte framing with incremental decode, JSON Schema, strict TypeScript Zod parsers, a small generation script, and cross-language golden-fixture infrastructure.
data.description: Implement stable IDs, version tags, bounded framing, base command/event/request/result/error envelopes, Rust schema support, strict-TypeScript runtime-schema generation, and golden-fixture infrastructure. Keep each domain DTO family in its owning core, worker, host, UI, portable, or bootstrap task so this foundation remains a medium-agent slice and framework/provider-native types cannot cross boundaries.
data.title: M01.3 — Implement shared protocol primitives and schema infrastructure
